research_notes: Initial review2026-10-01: APH, first speech, own biography, Asialink alumnus profile, IAG/Optus searches, parliamentary hearing and lobbyist records, historical Singtel annual report and ABR searched. No full-time evidence recovered; staff vacancy adverts refer to his employees, not him.

Follow-up: pre1996 career gap,2009–11 Enhance employment/consultancy dates and pay, employer historical reports or public CV proving personal hours,1998 secondment/leave, precise consultation cessation and business transition to FDRW. Do not extend2012 work until2024 ABN cancellation.

Optus ownership classification explicitly based on foreign state indirect majority ownership; preserve for integration review rather than silently equating listed status with private control. No totals possible without hours and continuity.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: contemporary reporting and public professional profile resolve Enhance chief-executive title and February 2009 commencement, with 2011 end year supported by older profile and governmental contact observations. No exact end or hours established.

Pre-1996 and IAG/Optus individual working-time searches did not resolve remaining gaps. Asialink old URL 404, WA tabled-paper PDF 403, current LinkedIn profile 429 Too Many Requests (not retried); other public evidence allowed work to continue. Unrelated football coach full-time appointment explicitly discarded.

Added Archives, ANU and Political Exchange Council governance separately. These appointments during Senate service do not extend pre-entry employment totals. Next leads: original Enhance appointment/release or accessible historical CV; reconciliation of newer profile excerpt, consultancy transition, all full-time/leave evidence and historical Optus control throughout tenure.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: publicly indexed current LinkedIn text gives Smith & Duda Consulting as 2010–April 2012. The April 2012 end month is consistent with Smith's 2 May Senate appointment and is adopted. The 2010 start conflicts with the frozen official 2011–12 range, 7 July 2011 partnership registration and older public profile's 2011 start, so no earlier start is inferred. Enhance end month, full-time terms, leave and pre-1996 history remain unresolved.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Read Singtel2008/09 historical primary report via public mirror; extended ownership evidence into2008/2009 without inferring individual hours or payroll entity. Additional2007/2008 mirror URLs were reported not accessible via search tool, leaving intervening verification for official archive. Corrected newer-profile metadata to reflect already-recorded3October consultancy evidence. Pre1996/IAG/full-time searches returned namesake UK communications founder, US educator and football coach, not this senator. IPART2005 correspondence is corroboration within known Optus service, not a new boundary. Enhance exit, conflicting2010 consultancy start, leave and personal hours remain unresolved.

Follow-up 2026-10-05: Recovered attributable Asialink provider biography at a new URL: added2004leadership-program completion and1981school exchange, separated from employment. Contemporary2004forumPDF and2003Senate witness index show IAG government-relations/policy title variant; no fabricated extra job or transition day. Enhance2011 contact tables still prove observations, not an exact exit or new2010consultancy commencement. Singtel2007/08 public mirror attempts returned404; official archive exposes only dynamic landing metadata, no intervening ownership record retrieved. Historical ownership classification preserved, hours/leave/payroll subsidiary and pre1996career still unresolved. Full2003report403 and oversized Asialink history PDF400 are individual source gaps; accessible provider evidence used instead. Next leads: original corporate personnel/CV and accessible intervening ownership reports.
